name: jira-service-management-mcp
description: Every Jira Service Management Cloud request-API (servicedeskapi) and Assets endpoint in one binary, plus SLA breach radar, internal notes, ticket timelines, and CMDB-to-ticket joins.

jira_service_management_api_token.title: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN
jira_service_management_api_token.description: Atlassian API token from id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens (Basic auth password).

jira_service_management_cloud_id.title: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_CLOUD_ID
jira_service_management_cloud_id.description: Assets only: your site's cloudId. Leave blank if you do not use Assets; 'cmdb discover' prints it.

jira_service_management_site.title: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_SITE
jira_service_management_site.description: Your Atlassian site subdomain: acme for acme.atlassian.net.

jira_service_management_workspace_id.title: JIRA_SERVICE_MANAGEMENT_WORKSPACE_ID
jira_service_management_workspace_id.description: Assets only: your site's workspaceId. Leave blank if you do not use Assets; 'cmdb discover' prints it.
